## Checklist

- [ ] `SKILL.md` frontmatter (`name`, `description`) is accurate and the description alone is enough to know when to trigger this skill.
- [ ] No hidden or unusual instructions — everything the skill tells an agent to do is visible in plain text, nothing obfuscated or conditionally hidden.
- [ ] Any script or command in `references/` is something you'd be comfortable running yourself; nothing fetches remote code or exfiltrates data.
- [ ] No employer, client, venture, or agent names (per the [conventions](../README.md#conventions) — org-specific content doesn't belong in this repo).
- [ ] `SKILL.md` stays reasonably short; detail that isn't needed on every trigger goes in `references/`.
